title: Rust main is red: 6 rpl_stack tests fail at main tip 9440ea90ea (multicast DIO/DIS/DAO suite)
description: Found by beads-worker-4 after merging main (merge had zero conflicts; my diff touched nothing in rpl_stack; verified identical failures on main directly — 301 passed / 6 failed, same set). Failing tests (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs): dao_radio_failure_retains_exact_finalized_bytes, leaf_send_allocates_each_update_and_restart_advances_sequence, relay_forwards_original_source_and_signed_body, rpl_dispatch_rejects_invalid_ipv6_length_and_checksum, three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent, multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received. Symptom of the latter: leaf.receive(1,1) no longer yields RplEvent::DioReceived (tests.rs:1099) — a DIO that used to be admitted is now rejected. Suspect the recent rpl admission/wire commits: 89cd460c0c (carry canonical multicast DIOs uncompressed), 623b13d54b (RPL control sends hop limit 255), 6008e4eed8 (RFC 6554 forwarding precedence parity + SRH admission vectors) — likely the tests' DIO/DIS construction (hop limit, wire form, or admission evidence) predates the tightened admission. Fix: update the 6 tests' frame construction to the new canonical admission requirements, or if a rejection is genuinely over-tight, file the divergence for adjudication. Owners of those commits (worker-1/worker-6) are best placed; filing because main's rust suite is red for every worker.
close_reason: RESOLVED (completed in prior rounds, closes now with the store consistent): all 6 originally failing rpl_stack tests pass on beads-worker-4 (lichen-node lib 307/307 verified repeatedly this session). Root causes were fixture drift, not admission-gate defects: (1) join_leaf delivered unicast-dst DIOs — reworked to canonical multicast via root.send_dio(multicast) (Rule 255, broadcast L2, hop 255; commit 79b2b87b76); (2) three_rpl_stacks + multicast_dio_and_dis relied on unicast solicited DIO delivery — under option A of the ehcn decision the solicited response re-targets ff02::1a, so relay/leaf hear it and the root drains the relay's multicast DIO echo before the relayed DAO (commit a24a9e2e90: transmit.rs send_dio re-targets RPL_ALL_NODES, destination param now _destination); (3) rpl_dispatch_rejects_invalid_ipv6_length_and_checksum passed unchanged. Note: rust lib tests are currently blocked repo-wide by the oscore merge artifact (zhm8, escalated — main's lichen-oscore has an unclosed delimiter); the 307/307 green was verified before that break landed and the fixes are already merged to main via the janitor. The canonical-multicast contract (option A) is the implemented state; ehcn/8rm3 threads informed.
